title: Reconcile and prepare exact admission-family performance measurement
summary: Rebind the admission cell space to the reviewed family catalog, add exact performance-only A0-A7 runtime authorization, preserve the deterministic dry-run campaign, complete the selected A0/A3/A4/A7 pilot, and execute the authorized counterbalanced A0-A7 follow-on through the ProtocolLab rack package boundary.
planned_changes: Keep factor-cell-space v3 and all retained timing-disabled and pilot controls immutable; preserve the exact manifest-bound performance-only admission token and production-seam package path; add an additive all-eight control and deterministic compiler that expands an eight-block Williams balanced Latin square into 64 one-repetition jobs; build one exact package per cell and reuse it across blocks; checkpoint every attempt for exact-identity resume; require bounded server output and sampled load-process telemetry while leaving incompatible intrusive target counter capture disabled; retain controller artifacts; and report cell, main, two-factor, and three-factor effects without accepting or activating a policy.
verification_plan: Validate all new canonical JSON against its schema and recompute hashes; prove every A0-A7 cell occupies every position once and every ordered first-order predecessor pair occurs once; prove fixture and 64-run manifest replay are byte-identical; reject unbalanced order, bounded cells, covering-array intent, outside axes, stale hashes, wrong host or workload, correctness intent, active intent, and performance-acceptance intent; prove package reuse, operator pause, and exact-identity resume; run focused runtime and package authorization tests; build source, raw server, adapter, and tests in Release; execute 64 isolated-pair one-repetition jobs; verify package identity, topology, payload bytes, runtime cell identity, activation and release accounting, failed and timeout counts, sampled load resource data, bounded output, and checksums; derive the declared full-factorial contrasts; validate the four touched SpecTrace artifacts directly; and run git diff --check.
completion_notes: The independently hosted A0/A3/A4/A7 pilot was rerun on plab-worker-x64-02 and plab-worker-x64-03 from clean source c9ff68a9811a01902cdc09549f843239f5dd4016 after the active-path snapshot race was fixed and raw-stream aggregate cadence was bounded. All eight repetitions transferred exact bytes with zero failures and timeouts, and compact server evidence stayed between 46,806 and 48,313 bytes. Canonical pilot result 2bdad29055956afea81f468700dd78602cf8381c35564ce7f5f61ccab5ee4412 remains directional because two serial repetitions cannot isolate batch from buffer or control execution-order drift. The earlier e92d00e8 / a172b883 balanced attempt accepted 23 of 64 rows before the source identity changed and is retained as historical, non-resumable evidence. The regenerated all-eight control b7b115e649b46b44f99c33deb4f6e3f7106c4421e7994bdefa5e4d44d02cfdad and manifest 005f39814881cbfff70b8d283b1ee5a8e0c430496db5b30141d2208e4aed024a preserve the deterministic compiler, resumable runner, bounded evidence checks, sampled load metrics, and disabled intrusive target-counter capture. Replacement 64-run rack execution and full-factorial reconciliation have not started.
out_of_scope: Accepting a performance policy or activating an adaptive rule
CI modification, push, or deletion of retained evidence
Presenting a local dry run or topology-incomplete rack run as credible performance evidence
Treating the balanced campaign as independent-host or independent-workload validation
